title.narrative: Philippines HIV NFM grant - Philippines (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Philippines, HIV, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: By 2017, the country will have maintained a prevalence of less than 6 HIV cases per 100,000 population (0.066%) by preventing the further spread of HIV infection and reducing the impact of the disease on individuals, families, sectors and communities. The objectives of this program are: To improve coverage and linkage of services from prevention and diagnosis among KP to treatment and care for PLHIV through an intensified delivery of quality and evidence based services. To intensify delivery of quality HIV and STI services through a strengthened support system by addressing barriers, improving linkages and ensuring delivery of critical enablers. To provide timely and evidence-based information for planning, monitaring, evaluation and quality assurance of HIV and STI program. To raise the awareness of key populations and the public on HIV and STI prevention and care services and increase demand and access to available HIV and STI services

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for PHL-H-SCP01
Number of needles and syringes distributed per person who injects drugs per year by needle and syringe programs
KP MSM-other 4: Percentage of HIGH RISK TG reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services and offered screening
TCS-other 2: Percent of newly diagnosed PLHIV who know their baseline CD4 count within the first 3 months of HIV diagnosis
KP MSM-other 1: Percentage of MSM reached who were tested and know their results
Percentage of people who inject drugs that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
TCS-other 1: Percentage of treatment eligible adults and children currently receiving ART
KP MSM-other 3: Number of MARCY (young MSMs) reached by HIV/AIDS prevention activities
Percentage of adults and children that initiated ART, with an undetectable viral load at 12 months (<1000 copies/ml)
Percentage of MSM reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of people who inject drugs reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
KP MSM-other 2: Percentage of TGW reached who were tested and know their results
Outcome indicators targets and results for PHL-H-SCP01
Percentage of KP who have received an HIV test in the past 12 months and know the results
Percent of KP who demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of HIV prevention and transmission
Percent of KP who report using a condom the last time they had sexual intercourse
Percentage of PWID who report non-sharing of injecting equipment last time they injected
Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
